edges.reason: Both sources report the same number of astronauts (4) for the SpaceX Crew-13 mission.

edges.sentence: On 2026-10-02, USA Today reported “Four astronauts have arrived at their new orbital home after launching from Florida on a SpaceX rocket.”; on the same day, NPR reported “SpaceX launched four astronauts on NASA's Crew-13 mission to the International Space Station for a six-month stay before returning to Earth.”.
